about_guarantee_body:
All our electronic products are covered by a manufacturer's warranty from the date of purchase (as shown on the invoice), according to each product:

* Monitors: 2-year warranty
* Fans: 1-year warranty
* Receivers: 1-year warranty

The warranty covers defects in manufacturing or internal components under normal use.

Not covered:
* Breakage, cracks, drops, shocks
* Liquid or moisture damage
* Electrical damage
* Misuse or incorrect connection
* Unauthorized repair or opening
* Removed serial number or unauthorized modifications
* Normal wear and tear
* Accessories unless stated otherwise

To claim warranty:
Provide the original invoice or proof of purchase.

Inspection:
3–7 business days.

If a defect is confirmed:
Repair, replacement, or refund per company policy.

Notes:
* The customer must deliver the product with all accessories
* Replacement continues the remaining warranty period
about_return_body:
We strive to provide high-quality products and complete customer satisfaction. If you encounter any issue, you can use our return and exchange policy according to the following conditions:

1. Return or Exchange Period
Customers have the right to request a return or exchange within 14 days of receipt, unless otherwise stated on the product.

2. Product Condition
The product must be in its original condition, unused, and free from damage, with all accessories, original packaging, and proof of purchase.

3. Conditions Under Which Returns or Exchanges Are Eligible
* Receiving a product different from the order
* A manufacturing defect
* Damage during shipping
* Product does not materially match the advertised specifications

4. Conditions Not Covered
* Misuse or damage after receipt
* Breakage or scratches caused by use
* Products that were installed or used in a way that damaged them
* Opened or used products that cannot be resold as new
* Requests submitted after the deadline

5. Inspection and Approval
The product is inspected upon receipt, and the request is approved after confirming that it meets the conditions.

6. Shipping Fees
The store covers the fees if the reason is a store error or a manufacturing defect; otherwise, the customer covers them.

7. Refund
The amount is refunded within 7 to 14 business days.

8. Replacement
The replacement product is sent after the returned item is received and inspected.

9. How to Request
Contact customer service and provide the order number and the reason for return.

analytics_subtitle: Traffic, engagement, and visitor behavior across your storefront.
analytics_active_hint: Recorded activity in the last 5 minutes
analytics_no_data_desc: Analytics starts collecting from the date this feature was enabled. Historical traffic before that date is not available.
analytics_error_desc: The dashboard could not reach the analytics service. Your storefront is unaffected.
analytics_definitions_note: Weeks start on Monday. Sessions end after 30 minutes without recorded activity. Active users are visitors with activity in the last 5 minutes. A visitor returning after 30 minutes of inactivity starts a new session.
analytics_admin_excluded: Admin dashboard visits are excluded from storefront analytics.
analytics_traffic_trend_desc: Unique visitors and page views for the selected period.
analytics_empty_chart: No traffic recorded in this period yet.
analytics_session_quality_desc: Based on sessions that started in the selected period and ended after 30 minutes of inactivity.
analytics_duration_tooltip: Estimated from the first to the last recorded activity in each session. Browser closures and abandoned tabs are inferred from the 30-minute inactivity timeout.
analytics_bounce_tooltip: A session is bounced when it has page views but no product view, wishlist addition, cart addition, or meaningful search. Only sessions ended by 30 minutes of inactivity are counted.
analytics_no_ended_sessions: No sessions have ended in this period yet. Results appear after 30 minutes without activity.
analytics_new_vs_returning_desc: Visitors with page views in the selected period.
analytics_new_tooltip: New: first seen during the selected period. Returning: first seen before the selected period. Clearing storage or using another device can make the same person appear new.
analytics_empty_returning: No visitors recorded in this period yet.
analytics_traffic_sources_desc: Sessions grouped by their original source. Internal navigation never changes the source.
analytics_empty_sources: No sessions recorded in this period yet.
analytics_traffic_tooltip: The source is set from utm_source or the external referrer when the session starts. Direct means no external referrer or campaign information was detected.
analytics_devices_desc: Sessions and unique visitors by device type detected from browser information.
analytics_empty_devices: No device data recorded in this period yet.
analytics_device_tooltip: Device type is inferred from the browser user agent. Operating systems are not used as device categories, and unrecognized devices stay Unknown.
analytics_top_products_desc: The five most viewed products in the selected period.
analytics_empty_products: No product views recorded in this period yet.
analytics_wishlist_desc: Actual successful wishlist additions, not button clicks.
analytics_empty_wishlist: No wishlist additions recorded in this period yet.
analytics_wishlist_tooltip: An addition is counted only when a new wishlist entry is actually created. Anonymous wishlist entries stored in the browser are included.
